added.summary: A desktop store package answers og.platform from the local document, kept in the player's data directory (Application Support, %APPDATA%, the XDG data home) across runs: the store and leaderboards work offline in every package.

@origingame/engine/provider: a store's provider for a desktop package, bundled with the game by `package.ts --provider <module>`; with `--provider-lib <lib>` it calls that library's one C entry, og_provider_call(method, json), through context.native. The store's SDK and credentials stay in the module and library.
